dishes.pairing_mechanics: Ice-cold still water (4-6°C) against hot fat creates a strong temperature contrast that rinses the fatty film from the tongue and resets taste between spoonfuls; clean neutral taste does not compete with cumin and carrot sweetness; sipping replaces sugary sodas at the table
dishes.physiological_impact: Very high fat load coats the palate and slows gastric emptying; salt and cumin raise thirst; post-meal heaviness and drowsiness, especially after midday wedding or Thursday osh
dishes.fat_and_spice_profile: Rice cooked in rendered lamb tail fat (dumba) and cottonseed oil, lamb or beef, yellow and red carrots, whole garlic heads, chickpeas, cumin (zira), barberry; served from a large kazan

framework.visual_style: Golden-hour or warm tungsten light (2700-3200K), soft diffusion, slow dolly-ins and gentle handheld, 24fps, shallow depth of field on hands and faces, long takes (3-5s), steam and candle/fire glow, product appears late (after second 6) and is poured for someone else, never for oneself
framework.neural_target: Hippocampus & Prefrontal Cortex (episodic memory, social-reward valuation)
framework.narrative_tone: Warm, slow, respectful, multi-generational; the product is a supporting character, family is the hero
framework.primary_trigger: Nostalgia, tradition and belonging. BioLife is positioned as the quiet, constant presence at the family dastarkhan - the water that is always on the table when the people you love are together.
framework.selection_rationale: Memorial Day: respectful, low-key content only.

guardrails.note: No sales push, no discounts, no humour; brand message limited to respect and remembrance.
